Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. The Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter is the top of the line: a 2026 model, fully loaded, the most premium party on wheels in the fleet. Fiber-optic lighting with eighteen modes takes the cabin from full dance party to something as quiet as roses and candlelight, and an ultra-premium sound system with bass and subwoofers carries it.

Request a quoteCall to reserve

About the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter

A wet bar with champagne glass holders, ambient lighting, automatic doors, a full partition and an intercom to your chauffeur round out the cabin. Fifteen seats, room for six bags.

It is the Sprinter groups ask for on a Scottsdale night, and it does birthdays, Valentine’s and evening events with the same energy.

Seats: Lounge seating for fifteen

Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $250 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $425. Seats 15, room for 6 bags.
